rules.note: Scan of the photo page of a private ordinary passport. If it has under 12 months left from the registration date, renew it and apply with the new one.
ID photo as a JPG file under 200 KB, at least 295 x 413 pixels.
Scan of your bachelor's degree certificate. If you have not graduated yet, upload an official letter from your university with your expected graduation date.
Scans of your bachelor's and master's degree certificates. If you have not graduated yet, upload an official letter from your university with your expected graduation date.
Scans of your undergraduate and graduate transcripts.
Proof of language proficiency meeting SJTU's Language Requirements for International Graduate Programs (see the PDF linked on the SJTU page).
Personal statement (submitted together with your study plan).
Study plan (submitted together with your personal statement).
Two academic recommendation letters, from associate professors or above, or from senior professionals in a related academic field.
Supervisor acceptance letter. Required only if you apply to one of the schools listed on the SJTU page for your degree level; contact a potential supervisor first.
Documents not in English or Chinese need a translation by an authorised translation agency; upload both the original and the translation.
